value.hook: read when a reviewer holds reviewer/<pr> but sits idle with no verdict
value.title: Reviewers that queue work for a 'next turn' stall

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Seen twice on 2026-11-09 with pij-whole-spoonbill (gpt-6.1-sol reviewer): it put the next review in its own task list or wrote "queued next turn" on its card (#205 after #202 at 15:12; #210 at 18:3x), then ended its turn. A queued item in a seat's own list never wakes it, so it sat idle with an empty prompt until a time-limit notice or PA check (49 min and over 1 h).

Spot it: a reviewer holding reviewer/<pr> with no reviewer verdict on that PR (git log in governance for "reviewer verdict on pr:<n>"), idle, with a card like "queued next turn" or "<pr> queued after <other>". Act: one ask to start it now in this turn, naming the head and the request id to answer with --answers. First check the PR isn't already merged (#205 merged before spoonbill started, so the ask had to be withdrawn). Report to pm-001 in one line.
